# Perth Roof Care | Ellis Services Group

> Perth Roof Care is operated by Ellis Services Group Pty Ltd. Roof repairs and drainage services in Perth. Available in English and 简体中文.

## English services

- [Roof repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/roof-repairs/): We inspect and repair tile and metal roofs, tracing leaks and restoring damaged tiles, ridges, valleys, flashings and roof-edge drainage.
- [Roof leak repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/roof-leak-repairs/): We trace roof leaks to their source and repair damaged tiles, metal sheets, fasteners, valleys and flashings.
- [Tile roof repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/tile-roof-repairs/): We repair concrete and terracotta tile roofs across Perth, replacing damaged tiles and restoring adjoining ridge, valley and flashing details.
- [Metal roof repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/metal-roof-repairs/): We repair Perth metal roofs, including corrugated sheets, fasteners, washers, ridge and hip capping, flashings and penetrations.
- [Ridge capping & repointing](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/ridge-capping-repointing/): We repair ridge capping and carry out repointing and rebedding for Perth tiled roofs.
- [Roof valleys & flashing repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/flashing-repairs/): We repair and replace roof valleys and flashings at walls, chimneys, skylights and penetrations.
- [Gutters & downpipes](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/gutters-downpipes/): We inspect, clean and repair connected gutters and downpipes across Perth.
- [Roof inspection](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/roof-inspection/): We inspect Perth roofs for leaks, damaged coverings, ridge and flashing defects and drainage problems.
- [Roof maintenance](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/roof-maintenance/): We maintain Perth tile and metal roofs through inspection, drainage clearing and targeted repairs.
- [Commercial roof repairs](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/commercial-roof-repairs/): We repair roofs for Perth businesses and managed properties, covering sheets, flashings, penetrations and drainage.

## 中文服务

- [屋面维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/roof-repairs/): 我们检查及维修瓦屋面和金属屋面，追踪渗漏，修复受损瓦片、屋脊、天沟、泛水板及屋面边缘排水构造。
- [屋面渗漏维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/roof-leak-repairs/): 我们追查屋面漏水源头，维修受损瓦片、金属板、紧固件、天沟及泛水板。
- [瓦屋面维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/tile-roof-repairs/): 我们在珀斯维修混凝土瓦及陶瓦屋面，更换损坏瓦片，修复相邻屋脊、天沟及泛水板细部。
- [金属屋面维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/metal-roof-repairs/): 我们维修珀斯金属屋面，涵盖波纹板、紧固件、垫圈、正脊及斜脊盖板、泛水板和穿透部位。
- [屋脊盖瓦与重新勾缝](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/ridge-capping-repointing/): 我们为珀斯瓦屋面维修屋脊盖瓦，并进行重新勾缝及重新铺设座浆。
- [屋面天沟及泛水板维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/flashing-repairs/): 我们维修和更换墙面、烟囱、天窗及穿透部位的屋面天沟与泛水板。
- [檐沟与落水管](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/gutters-downpipes/): 我们在珀斯检查、清洁及维修相连檐沟与落水管。
- [屋面检查](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/roof-inspection/): 我们检查珀斯屋面的漏水、覆盖材料损坏、屋脊及泛水板缺陷和排水问题。
- [屋面维护](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/roof-maintenance/): 我们通过检查、排水清理及针对性维修维护珀斯瓦屋面和金属屋面。
- [商业屋面维修](https://www.perthroofcare.com.au/zh/commercial-roof-repairs/): 我们为珀斯企业及受托管理物业维修屋面，涵盖板材、泛水板、穿透部位及排水。
